sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Project cover sheet. Shows design team (BFA, Broyles structural, Hoggard/Eure civil), index of drawings, building data table, code information, asbestos/lead statements. Building Data: Use Groups S2/B, Construction Type IIB, 2-story building height 42'-3". Floor areas: Below Roadway 5,097 SF existing/0 renovated; Roadway level 4,726 SF existing/0 renovated; Basement 9,945 SF existing/0 renovated; 1st Floor 9,945 SF existing/3,471 SF renovated; 2nd Floor 5,525 SF existing/3,609 SF renovated; Roof Plan 9,945 SF existing; Total 44,983 SF existing/8,418 SF renovated. Occupant load totals: 15 roadway, 11 basement, 34 first floor, 62 second floor = 151 total. Fully sprinklered: NO. Fire alarm: YES.

sheets.title: DOWNTOWN TUNNEL (PORTSMOUTH) PUMP BUILDING SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Site plan at 1'=10' scale. Shows existing building footprint adjacent to Elizabeth River/downtown tunnel portal area in Portsmouth. New electric generator shown on platform (top of concrete platform elevation 7.50). Concrete pad elevation 10.00. New underground electrical conduit shown running from generator pad to building (see Sheet ES101). Fuel fill connection shown (fuel fill elevation 4.37). Generator sits outside the support building in a weatherproof enclosure. Site is within floodplain (base flood elevation noted as 8.00', bottom of generator elevation 11.00'). Flood vent locations noted on existing building.

sheets.title: COVER SHEET (STRUCTURAL)
sheets.reading_notes: Structural general notes and cast-in-place concrete notes. Confirms CAT 3512C generator total weight 115,000 lbs. Seismic design category D, site class D. Wind: 125 mph (3-second gust). Allowable soil bearing 1,000 psf per geotech report. Foundation designed as mat slab. Structure designed per 2015 VUSBC.

sheets.title: FOUNDATION AND SLAB PLANS
sheets.reading_notes: Foundation plan and elevated slab plan at 1/4"=1'-0" scale. Shows mat foundation approximately 32' x 12.5' (per geotech report). 1'-0" thick concrete mat foundation with reinforcing. Elevated slab at elevation +7.5 for generator platform. Stairs to generator level. Anchor bolt locations coordinated with generator manufacturer (Chillicothe Metal Company identified in notes). Generator support frame sits on 8" concrete walls below the slab platform.

sheets.title: SECTIONS AND DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Structural sections and reinforcing details at 3/4"=1'-0" scale. Shows concrete wall reinforcing, mat foundation interface, stair details, handrail post embedment. Galvanized steel railing at stairs and platform. 8" concrete foundation walls. Generator support frame detail with anchor bolts.

sheets.title: LEGEND AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical legend (new/existing/demolition symbols for 208V/120V and 480V/277V equipment) and 19-step project phasing sequence. Key phasing: (1) Site preparation; (2) Install underground conduit; (3) Install emergency generator pad and switchboard MDPE housekeeping pad; (4-5) Conduit runs external to building; (6) Continue emergency generator feed conduits to new switchboard MDPE; (7) Install new ATS units; (8) Install conduit from new switchboard MDPE to new ATSs; (9-10) Install and connect emergency feed cabling from switchboard to ATSs; (11) Install and connect cabling from emergency generator to switchboard MDPE; (12) Install new control wiring for auto start emergency generator; (13) Transfer and polish fuel from underground fuel storage to new emergency generator fuel tank; (14-15) Modify existing normal feeders from switchgear to ATSs #2 and #3; (16) Commission new emergency diesel generator; (17) Modify existing panel TDP conduit and wiring back to new switchboard MDPE; (18) Abandon existing underground fuel tank; (19) Abandon existing emergency generator, supply/exhaust ducts, day tank, and all associated fuel piping.
